profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Software Architect | Platform Modernization | Distributed Systems | C#/.NET | AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.summary:
I’m a Principal Software Engineer and Software Architect with 20+ years of experience designing, modernizing, and building business-critical software platforms.

Most of my career has been spent taking complex systems and making them simpler, faster, and easier to evolve. I’ve led modernization efforts across government, healthcare, legal, financial, and enterprise software environments, while staying hands-on with architecture, APIs, domain modeling, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and production code.

I’m particularly interested in platform modernization, distributed and event-driven systems, domain-driven design, API architecture, and high-volume data platforms. Earlier in my career, I led the architecture of a pharmacy inventory and procurement platform managing more than 100,000 pharmaceutical products across multiple national wholesalers. I’ve also designed large-scale government systems processing millions of records, multi-tenant legal platforms, authentication frameworks, and integration-heavy enterprise applications.

My approach to architecture is practical: good architecture should make teams faster over time, not create more ceremony. I like establishing clear service boundaries, reusable patterns, strong APIs, and engineering standards that help developers solve business problems without constantly fighting the platform.

I’ve always remained a hands-on engineer. I enjoy working with senior engineers, reviewing architecture and code, mentoring developers, exploring new technologies, and validating ideas by building real software. I'm also an enthusiastic adopter of AI-assisted engineering, using Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and ChatGPT throughout my daily workflow for architecture, implementation, refactoring, testing, and code review. I believe AI is fundamentally changing software development while making experienced engineering judgment more valuable than ever.

My strongest technical background is in C#/.NET, Angular, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Azure, GCP, Docker, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and modern API design.

The work I enjoy most is solving difficult technical problems, modernizing systems with a lot of history, and leaving platforms in a better state than I found them.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Architect (Consulting)
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer and architect delivering cloud-based systems in C#/.NET and Angular for public and private sector clients. I typically own work end-to-end: architecture, implementation, performance/reliability improvements, and production support.

Recent focus areas:

Platform modernization: microservices/APIs, clean architecture, CI/CD, and operational hardening (caching, async/cancellation, hot-path tuning).

Authentication/authorization frameworks: provider-agnostic integrations supporting multiple third-party identity providers (OIDC/OAuth patterns).

High-stakes workflow automation: replaced a year-long manual tax-rate process with an event-driven precompute pipeline; enabled statewide rate generation in ~30 seconds.

Selected client engagements include:

Mullen Coughlin (data breach / incident response & litigation workflows)

Bank Technology (authn/authz modernization and platform performance work)

Idaho Department of Labor (mainframe modernization + high-scale computation)
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Angular · Microsoft Azure · PostgreSQL · Redis · OAuth · Containerization · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Angular Material · JavaScript · Entity Framework · Microsoft SQL Server · Tailwind CSS · C# · TypeScript · Docker · DevOps · OpenID Connect (OIDC)
